description: This file defines a Data Access Object (DAO) interface for managing category options in a local database, specifically handling operations related to category sorting methods within the Nextcloud Notes Android client.

classes.name: CategoryOptionsDao
classes.description: Interface defining database operations for category options, including adding options, modifying category order, and retrieving category sorting methods.

methods.name: addCategoryOptions
methods.description: Inserts a new CategoryOptions entity into the database.

methods.name: modifyCategoryOrder
methods.description: Updates the sorting method for a specific category and account.

methods.name: getCategoryOrder
methods.description: Retrieves the sorting method for a specific category and account as LiveData.

calls: UPDATE CategoryOptions SET sortingMethod = :sortingMethod WHERE category = :category AND accountId = :accountId
SELECT sortingMethod FROM CategoryOptions WHERE accountId = :accountId AND category = :category
